subtitle.board: Board view — kanban across job phases

notice.unavailableBody: The print queue is managed by the desktop app — run Pluryprint to see and control jobs.
notice.errorBody: The queue could not be read.
notice.errorHint: Nothing was lost — the jobs are still in the desktop app. Retry to read the queue again.

empty.title: No jobs in the queue
empty.body: Print something and it will show up here — active, pending, and recently finished jobs.

progress.label: Progress of {{file}}
progress.indeterminate: In progress — the print spooler reports no percentage

note.interruptedByShutdown: Interrupted by shutdown · resume to continue
note.heldByPrinter: Held in the system print queue · release it there to print
note.printerNeedsAttention: The printer needs attention (paper, ink or offline)

confirm.clearMessage_one: Clear {{count}} finished job? It leaves the history — you get {{seconds}} seconds to undo.
confirm.clearMessage_other: Clear {{count}} finished jobs? They leave the history — you get {{seconds}} seconds to undo.
confirm.cancelMessage: “{{file}}” is printing. Cancel it? Pages already sent to the printer may still come out.
confirm.cancelAllMessage_one: {{count}} job that has not finished will be cancelled. This cannot be undone, and pages already sent to the printer may still come out.
confirm.cancelAllMessage_other: {{count}} jobs that have not finished will be cancelled. This cannot be undone, and pages already sent to the printer may still come out.

toast.undoTooLate: Too late to undo — the finished jobs were already cleared.

notify.batchUnconfirmed_one: {{unconfirmed}} file (of {{total}}) was sent to the printer without confirmation that it printed
notify.batchUnconfirmed_other: {{unconfirmed}} files (of {{total}}) were sent to the printer without confirmation that they printed
notify.batchFailedHint: {{file}}: {{error}} — open the logs folder for the full job log entry.
notify.jobNeedsActionHint: {{error}} — fix it, then resume the job from the queue.
notify.alreadyFinished: “{{file}}” had already finished — there was nothing to cancel.
notify.liveUnavailable: Live queue updates are unavailable — reopen the app to retry.

fix.alreadyInstalled: {{name}} is installed now — resuming the job.
fix.resumed_one: {{name}} is installed. The job that needed it is resuming.
fix.resumed_other: {{name}} is installed. The {{count}} jobs that needed it are resuming.
fix.printersFailed: The printers to send it to could not be loaded.

codes.conversion_timeout: The conversion took longer than {{secs}} s and was stopped.
codes.conversion_failed: The file could not be converted for printing: {{detail}}
codes.unsupported_setting: The driver for “{{printer}}” does not support this setting: {{detail}}
codes.print_timeout: The printer did not finish within {{secs}} s. The job is still in the system print queue: check the printer before retrying.
codes.print_unconfirmed: Sent to the printer, but the system print queue did not confirm that it printed. Check the printer before printing it again.
codes.printer_unavailable: Printer “{{printer}}” is not installed. Choose another printer.
codes.printer_disabled: Printer “{{printer}}” was removed from Pluryprint. Restore it on the Printers screen, or choose another printer.
codes.os_cancelled: The job was cancelled in the system print queue.
codes.print_aborted: The printer aborted the job. Check the printer, then retry.
codes.interrupted_by_shutdown: Pluryprint was closed while this job was in progress.
codes.pdf_protected: This PDF is protected and cannot be printed as it is.

conversion_timeout.converter: The converter did not finish in time and was stopped: {{detail}}
conversion_timeout.tool_timed_out: {{tool}} did not finish within {{secs}} s and was stopped.

print_timeout.spooler: Sending the job to the printer took longer than {{secs}} s and was stopped.

print_unconfirmed.left_queue: The job left the system print queue without reporting that it printed: it may have printed, or been deleted there. Check the printer before printing it again.
print_unconfirmed.untracked: The system print queue accepted the job but gives no way to follow it, so whether it printed is unknown. Check the printer before printing it again.
print_unconfirmed.tracking_failed: The system print queue stopped answering while the job was printing, so whether it printed is unknown. Check the printer before printing it again.
print_unconfirmed.not_verifiable: Pluryprint was closed while this job was in the system print queue and cannot tell it apart from other jobs any more, so whether it printed is unknown. Check the printer before printing it again.

printer_unavailable.no_printer: No printer is configured. Choose a printer first.
printer_unavailable.ambiguous: Several printers are named “{{printer}}” ({{candidates}}). Choose one on the Printers screen or remove the duplicate.

unsupported_setting.duplex: The driver for “{{printer}}” cannot print two-sided.
unsupported_setting.paper: The driver for “{{printer}}” does not offer the paper size {{paper}}.

conversion_failed.workdir_failed: Pluryprint could not prepare a temporary folder for the conversion. Check the free disk space.
conversion_failed.cannot_write_output: The converted PDF could not be saved. Check the free disk space.
conversion_failed.converter_failed: {{tool}} could not convert this file to PDF.
conversion_failed.converter_start_failed: {{tool}} is installed but could not be started.
conversion_failed.pdf_invalid: This is not a valid PDF file.
conversion_failed.pdf_truncated: The PDF is truncated or damaged.
conversion_failed.pdf_decrypt_failed: The PDF was unlocked but could not be prepared for printing.
conversion_failed.image_damaged: The image is damaged or uses a variant of its format that cannot be read.
conversion_failed.heif_decode_failed: The HEIC/HEIF photo could not be decoded; it may be damaged.
conversion_failed.heif_size_unsupported: HEIC/HEIF images of {{width}}×{{height}} are not supported.
conversion_failed.svg_invalid: This SVG file is damaged or is not a valid SVG image.
conversion_failed.svg_too_large: This SVG image is larger than the {{limit}} MB limit once uncompressed.
conversion_failed.svg_convert_failed: The SVG image could not be converted to PDF.
conversion_failed.render_failed: The page could not be laid out for printing.
conversion_failed.render_worker_missing: The Pluryprint app, which lays out pages for printing, was not found next to the command-line tool. Reinstall Pluryprint.
conversion_failed.share_reference_refused: The page uses a file on a network share, which the browser renderer cannot load safely. Print it with the system renderer.
conversion_failed.text_unreadable: The text file could not be read as text.

print_failed.sumatra_exit: SumatraPDF could not send the job to the printer (exit code {{status}}).
print_failed.spooler_rejected: The system print service rejected the job.
print_failed.wait_failed: Pluryprint lost track of the print process. Check the printer before retrying.

unsupported_format.no_extension: This file has no extension, so its type is unknown.
unsupported_format.gif_not_supported: GIF images are not supported. Convert the image to PNG or JPEG first.

pdf_protected.password_required: This PDF is protected with a password. Enter it to print the file.
pdf_protected.password_incorrect: That password does not open this PDF. Check it and try again.
pdf_protected.printing_not_allowed: The author of this PDF does not allow it to be printed.
pdf_protected.unsupported_encryption: This PDF uses a type of encryption Pluryprint cannot open.

password.title: This PDF needs a password
password.body: “{{file}}” is protected. Enter its password to print it. Pluryprint uses it only for this job: it is not saved anywhere and is forgotten when the job ends.
password.label: PDF password
password.applyToBatch_one: Also try it on the other protected PDF of this batch
password.applyToBatch_other: Also try it on the other {{count}} protected PDFs of this batch
password.incorrect: That password does not open this PDF. Check it and try again.
password.waiting: Password received. The job is waiting its turn in the queue; the password is checked when the file is converted.
password.waitingPaused: Password received, but the queue is paused: the password is checked once you resume the queue.
